commodities_morning.timing_semantics: best_effort target start, not a fixed report-completion SLA; wait for required inputs and record actual generated_at
commodities_morning.target_window: 07:00 through China cash-market open, subject to source readiness

commodities_evening.timing_semantics: best_effort target start, not a fixed report-completion SLA; wait for required inputs and record actual generated_at
commodities_evening.target_window: after the China day-session data is ready and before the relevant night-session decision window

direct_write_policy: prepare the final contents for all six required paths first, then create or update each required path directly on main through the GitHub connector; if atomic Git-data operations are safely available they may be used, but they are not required
success_condition: archive_status=success only after all six required paths have been re-read from main and verified for the current report_date and edition
partial_condition: if some required main writes or post-write verification steps fail, archive_status=partial
failure_condition: if formal archive cannot be written to main, archive_status=failed
manifest_policy: report_date+edition is the unique key; update an existing entry instead of appending a duplicate; write the manifest exactly once after the other five paths are final and re-read
github_failure_policy: report the failing main path and error; never suppress the research report
archive_status_semantics: archive_status=success means all required files are confirmed present on main for the current report; success does not imply CI validation passed
ci_validation_semantics: Validate Radar Reports is post-push validation only; do not wait for it and do not let CI block Scheduled Task completion; if the result is unavailable record ci_validation_status=pending_or_unverified
completion_policy: after all six main paths are re-read and verified, end the Scheduled Task immediately; do not poll CI, create branches, create PRs, merge, or perform branch cleanup
citation_policy: GitHub Markdown uses ordinary Markdown links or footnotes; never write ChatGPT-only citation tokens such as filecite, cite, memcite, turn-search IDs or private connector IDs
source_policy: JSON stores a structured sources array with title, publisher, URL when available, source date, access time and supported claims

commodity_input_data.partial_option_trade_structure_disclaime: research only; manual quote and manual confirmation required before execution; no premium quoted

idempotency.scheduled_run: update the same historical date/edition path if it already exists
idempotency.manual_test: write only under tests/ unless explicitly promoted

never_write: non-public employer information unless expressly approved
